record.source_episode: Approved KSU implementation/testing guides plus executed Isolette Rust backend and component diagnostics
record.trigger: GUMBO contracts exist but code generation emits C, Rust generation rejects an expression, or component proofs/GUMBOX fail on missing outputs.
record.principle: Select the documented Rust implementation language explicitly. Check backend representation compatibility before assuming missing behavioral contracts. Preserve generated requirements and implement the application entry points, initializing every output DataPort and maintaining state/output consistency. Run Verus and generated GUMBOX tests separately; missing output panics and violated postconditions guide repairs without weakening contracts.
record.semantic_choice: An implementation-language or numeric-expression backend failure is not absence of English/GUMBO behavior. Integer time encoding is a reviewed sampling/units abstraction, not automatic proof of physical time.
record.structural_placement: Model HAMR_AADL thread implementation-language property; generated component app bodies and user test file. Preserve generated bridge, executable GUMBOX contracts and proof ensures clauses.
record.repair_gate: Parse and generate Rust; verify component implementation with Verus; execute initialization/compute/GSV GUMBOX suites and explicit units; retain failed counterexamples and repeat affected checks. A passing diagnostic-output implication does not establish platform fault detection.
prerequisites: Approved KSU workflow and selected model
exclusions: Claiming a C build as a Rust/Verus proof
Removing postconditions or adding assumptions to suppress failures
Claiming five test functions prove five requirements
Claiming sampled ticks prove a physical deadline

parameters.name: output_ports
parameters.constraints: Publish required DataPorts during initialize; update per exact contracts

parameters.name: backend_representation
parameters.constraints: Preserve units/bounds; expose sampling, progress and overflow obligations

target_compatibility: KSU HAMR SysML/GUMBO system properties with Sireum 4.20260810.80aad0c2
preserved_obligations: Supported in-scope requirements and mandatory gates
Original English inventory with excluded features retained
Negative and transfer evidence for rule applicability

counterexample.scenario: The generated failure reporter never writes its output. Verus rejects its conditional postcondition and GUMBOX initialization panics on an absent DataPort value.
counterexample.expected_difference: Implement propagation of the existing diagnostic flag without changing the contract, then repeat both tools. Do not claim the fault-detection mechanism itself was verified.

record.notes: Session-curated draft using approved KSU guides and executed supervised development feedback. Not independently transferred or published. Original source/golden/contracts preserved. No paid extraction.
positive_paraphrases: implement the existing guarantee in the owning entry point
misleading_near_matches: a generated contract is an implemented behavior

semantic_roles.temporal_scope: explicit abstract schedule; real-time bounds separate

record.formal_output_pattern: Backend selection -> supported representation -> generated contracts -> owned app body -> Verus + GUMBOX -> exact-scope evidence and limitations.
allowed_edit_scope: new draft repair rule and reviewed capability scope
required_baseline: Approved English and compatible pinned system-check tool
